research_question: Under what SFU ACT policies (strip; rewrite-to-SFU-clock after SR; verbatim) do E2E capture-to-playout estimators remain unbiased while keeping cross-track A/V sync within a bound ε fixed before measurement?

sync_bound_epsilon.definition: Decision uses |sync_err| ≤ ε_ms. sync_err is the signed cross-track A/V capture-time difference at matched playout marks (formula frozen below).

citation_primary.title: Relative timing of sound and vision for broadcasting
citation_primary.notes: Detectability thresholds about +45 ms to −125 ms (positive = sound advanced w.r.t. vision). Acceptability about +90 ms to −185 ms. Asymmetric — not a symmetric ±40 ms band.

citation_supporting.notes: Often summarized as about +40 ms / −60 ms at output feeding transmitters (see NAB lip-sync overview citing EBU R37).
Summarizes ITU detectability and compares ATSC/EBU distribution tolerances.

sync_bound_epsilon.justification: Jay selected the conversational lip-sync (~±40 ms) class. Pilot adopts a conservative symmetric research bound |sync_err| ≤ 40 ms, near ITU-R BT.1359-1 sound-lead detectability (~+45 ms) and in the same class as EBU R37’s +40 ms audio-early figure. Full ITU asymmetry is recorded; we do not pretend BT.1359 states ±40 ms.

latency_bias_tolerance.definition: Tolerance on |b| where b = L̂ − L*. L̂ = t_playout_wall − t_capture_from_ACT (or ACT-extrapolated). L* = t_playout_wall − (t_inject_wall − Δ_inject) with known publisher inject delay Δ_inject.
latency_bias_tolerance.sla_sentence: Observability must stay within 10 ms of true capture→playout latency.
latency_bias_tolerance.jay_choice: 2026-09-17: Set τ_b = 10 ms — observability must stay within 10 ms of true capture→playout

metric_formulas_frozen.sync_err: At matched playout marks for audio and video: sync_err_ms = (t_capture_audio − t_capture_video) in ms. Prefer ACT-derived capture times when present; if a track lacks ACT, mark cell apparatus_partial and do not invent substitutes for the primary sync metric.
metric_formulas_frozen.latency_estimate_Lhat: L̂_ms = (t_playout_wall − t_capture_from_ACT) in ms, same playout-mark definition across policies.
metric_formulas_frozen.bias_b: b_ms = L̂_ms − L*_ms (signed). Primary summary: median b over the fixed analysis window; also report |b|.
metric_formulas_frozen.negative_control: getStats RTT / candidate-pair RTT collected every trial; MUST NOT be used as L̂ or to set τ_b.

decision_rule_preregistered.tradeoff_positive_if: (|b_rewrite| > 10 ms) OR (|sync_err_verbatim| > 40 ms) under any required completed cell C1–C4 (or both). That is the publishable tension.
decision_rule_preregistered.prefer_rewrite_if: |b_rewrite| ≤ 10 ms AND |sync_err_rewrite| ≤ 40 ms when both tracks measurable
decision_rule_preregistered.one_line_boolean: GO trade-off = rewrite_bias_exceeds_10ms OR verbatim_sync_exceeds_40ms; else NEGATIVE/INCONCLUSIVE per plan outcome vocabulary; apparatus failures classified separately.
